definition: The tight 8 are the school-subject spine lanes that can be translated downward from FET to Senior, Intermediate and Foundation phases.

subjects.fet_anchor: English Home Language / English First Additional Language

phase_translation.fet_10_12: language_integrated_assessment: comprehension, visual literacy, summary, transactional/creative writing
phase_translation.senior_7_9: language_integrated_assessment: source reading, language-in-context, paragraph response
phase_translation.intermediate_4_6: guided_language_task: text comprehension, vocabulary, simple visual interpretation
phase_translation.foundation_1_3: early_language_task: oral prompt, picture prompt, phonics/vocabulary, sentence response

done_definition: official/curricular text and visual source candidates are embedded
language shell handles comprehension, visual literacy and writing tasks separately
reading and writing load obeys grade ladder

subjects.fet_anchor: Afrikaans Home Language / Afrikaans First Additional Language

phase_translation.fet_10_12: language_integrated_assessment: comprehension, visual literacy, summary, writing
phase_translation.senior_7_9: language_integrated_assessment: source reading, taal-in-konteks, paragraph response
phase_translation.foundation_1_3: early_language_task: oral/picture prompts, vocabulary, sentence response

done_definition: Afrikaans source exemplars are added to the source bank
language shell supports Afrikaans instructions and memo wording
HL/FAL/SAL level is explicit in the request and receipt

phase_translation.fet_10_12: calculation_problem_solving: graph, geometry, algebra, data handling
phase_translation.senior_7_9: pre_fet_problem_solving: multi-step calculations, graphs, geometry and pattern reasoning
phase_translation.intermediate_4_6: guided_problem_solving: number operations, tables, simple graphs, measurement
phase_translation.foundation_1_3: concrete_number_task: number line, counting objects, shapes, measurement pictures

done_definition: graph/diagram/table source candidates are readable
answers are mechanically derivable from supplied values
memo separates method, substitution, final answer and unit marks

phase_translation.fet_10_12: practical_performance_or_portfolio: scenario, reflection, project and rubric evidence
phase_translation.senior_7_9: life_orientation_task: scenario response, decision-making, wellbeing/citizenship evidence
phase_translation.intermediate_4_6: life_skills_task: personal/social wellbeing, creative arts/physical education evidence
phase_translation.foundation_1_3: life_skills_activity: oral/picture prompt, observation checklist, concrete wellbeing/environment tasks

done_definition: assessment avoids unsafe/private/sensitive prompts
portfolio/performance evidence is separated from written reflection
educator observation rubric is always included

subjects.display_name: Life Sciences -> Natural Sciences Life Strand

phase_translation.fet_10_12: data_diagram_practical_investigation: biological data, diagrams, investigation reasoning
phase_translation.senior_7_9: natural_sciences_life_living: diagrams, practical observations, data interpretation
phase_translation.intermediate_4_6: natural_sciences_technology_life_living: labelled diagrams, simple tables, observation sheets

done_definition: biology diagrams are source-verified or explicitly schematic
Life Sciences graph exemplar gap is closed
human/anatomy diagrams are blocked until educator/source review

subjects.display_name: Physical Sciences -> Natural Sciences Physical Strand

phase_translation.foundation_1_3: life_skills_beginning_knowledge: materials, weather, movement, simple observation tasks

done_definition: source graph/diagram/table candidates are readable
all calculation questions include values and units
unsafe practical instructions are blocked

phase_translation.fet_10_12: source_based_plus_extended_response: maps, climate, geomorphology, settlement/economic sources
phase_translation.senior_7_9: social_sciences_geography: maps, climate, population, settlement, resource sources
phase_translation.intermediate_4_6: social_sciences_geography: simple maps, photographs, diagrams, tables
phase_translation.foundation_1_3: life_skills_beginning_knowledge: places, weather, environment, simple map/picture awareness

done_definition: maps and photos are object-level curated, not page dumps
source classifier mismatches are resolved before release
questions never ask learners to answer from a missing map/visual

phase_translation.fet_10_12: source_based_plus_essay: source reliability, evidence comparison, essay argument
phase_translation.senior_7_9: social_sciences_history: source evidence, cause/effect, paragraph explanation
phase_translation.intermediate_4_6: social_sciences_history: stories, timelines, pictures, simple source questions

done_definition: each source set has provenance and visible evidence
essay/paragraph length is phase appropriate
memo accepts defensible evidence-linked answers

extensions.reason_not_spine: valuable FET product, but it maps directly to Senior Phase EMS and only indirectly to Foundation/Intermediate money and community themes

carry_down.intermediate_4_6: Mathematics money/data and Social Sciences community/economy themes
carry_down.foundation_1_3: Life Skills/Mathematics money, needs/wants and community helper concepts

release_rule: No subject is sellable until source release gates are cleared and educator approval is recorded.
